create_continuous_sac_policy_learner: create a ContinuousSoftActorCritic policy learner with a BoxSpace action space and default hyperparameters
train_sac_with_learn_batch: train the SAC policy learner on a TransitionBatch and return actor critic loss metrics
compute_critic_loss_sac: compute the twin critic action value loss for a batch of transitions using clipped double Q-learning
compute_actor_loss_sac: compute the actor loss using entropy regularization and minimum of twin critic Q-values
compare_sac_policy_learners: compare two ContinuousSoftActorCritic instances and return a string describing differences in entropy settings
